fields.name: record_id
fields.source_semantics: Append-only normalized record identity, not an official draw fact.
fields.normalization: Deterministic game/issue/evidence identity; source Unicode is preserved.

fields.name: game
fields.source_semantics: Frozen game identifier: dlt or ssq.
fields.normalization: Lowercase controlled vocabulary.

fields.name: issue_id
fields.source_semantics: Canonical four-digit-year issue identifier.
fields.normalization: Preserve SSQ YYYYNNN; expand official DLT YYNNN to YYYYNNN while retaining the raw issue in evidence payload.

fields.name: front_numbers
fields.source_semantics: Official published winning numbers for DLT front zone or SSQ red zone, not physical draw order.
fields.normalization: Two-character zero-padded strings, strictly ascending, unique and range checked.

fields.name: back_numbers
fields.source_semantics: Official published winning numbers for DLT back zone or SSQ blue zone, not physical draw order.
fields.normalization: Two-character zero-padded strings, strictly ascending, unique and range checked.

fields.name: draw_at
fields.source_semantics: Officially evidenced draw event timestamp; scheduled time is not silently promoted to actual time.
fields.normalization: RFC3339 UTC Z. The frozen normalized-record schema currently cannot represent an unknown exact time; such a record must remain unverified until a contract revision or exact official evidence exists.

fields.name: page_published_at
fields.source_semantics: Timestamp explicitly published by the official page.
fields.normalization: RFC3339 UTC Z; null when the page only shows a date or no publication time. Never derived from URL or HTTP headers.

fields.name: http_date
fields.source_semantics: HTTP Date response header for the captured response.
fields.normalization: RFC3339 UTC Z; null when absent; never substitutes for publication or draw time.

fields.name: first_seen_at
fields.source_semantics: First valid observation by this system for the same official content.
fields.normalization: RFC3339 UTC Z from a clock-qualified run.

fields.name: retrieved_at
fields.source_semantics: Completion time of this exact HTTP retrieval.
fields.normalization: RFC3339 UTC Z from a clock-qualified run.

fields.name: corrected_at
fields.source_semantics: Officially evidenced correction timestamp.
fields.normalization: RFC3339 UTC Z; null unless the official channel supplies correction evidence.

fields.name: available_at
fields.source_semantics: Conservative earliest time the verified record may be consumed downstream.
fields.normalization: Maximum of the evidence-supported availability constraints; never backfilled from draw schedule or URL date.

fields.name: number_space_version
fields.source_semantics: Version of zones, ranges and count of selected numbers.
fields.normalization: Controlled rule-bundle identifier.

fields.name: draw_process_version
fields.source_semantics: Version of the officially documented draw process, kept separate from device identity claims.
fields.normalization: Controlled rule-bundle identifier; no inferred process change.

fields.name: prize_rule_version
fields.source_semantics: Base prize and allocation rule version.
fields.normalization: Controlled rule-bundle identifier; promotions remain separate.

fields.name: active_promotion_ids
fields.source_semantics: Zero or more concurrent national prize-rule overlays active for the issue.
fields.normalization: Sorted unique controlled identifiers; provincial marketing or ticket-gift campaigns are excluded.

fields.name: status
fields.source_semantics: Event-sourced validation status.
fields.normalization: Controlled vocabulary and frozen transition policy.

fields.name: corroboration_tier
fields.source_semantics: Evidence topology tier, not a probability score.
fields.normalization: corroborated_official, shared_upstream, or primary_only according to actual channels.

fields.name: evidence_refs
fields.source_semantics: Immutable evidence manifest identifiers supporting the record.
fields.normalization: Unique stable references; at least one.

fields.name: supersedes
fields.source_semantics: Prior record identity superseded by this append-only revision.
fields.normalization: Null for initial record; otherwise exact earlier record_id.
